shots.image: Photorealistic vertical shot of a slim, graceful ruddy Somali cat with a medium-long ticked coat in warm cinnamon-red with darker brown ticking, a fluffy cream-tinted chest ruff, a big bushy fox-like tail, large tufted ears and bright amber-green eyes, standing upright on its hind legs on gently wet cobblestones in a quiet small-town square at blue-hour evening, both front paws raised together at chest height, a tall Christmas tree glowing with warm golden fairy lights and red baubles behind it, strings of warm round bulbs overhead, light soft snowflakes drifting, warm bokeh lights, the whole cat clearly visible from ears to tail in the lower middle of the frame, cosy festive mood, vertical composition
shots.motion: From the very first frame the ruddy Somali cat is already bouncing on its hind legs to the beat, patting its two front paws together in a quick rhythm while its bushy tail sways side to side and its head bobs with every beat, mouth closed. The tree's golden fairy lights twinkle and soft snowflakes drift down. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

shots.edit: Keep exactly the same slim ruddy Somali cat with the same fur pattern, face and eye color. Same cobblestone town square with the glowing Christmas tree and warm string lights. The cat now strikes a final dance pose, still upright on its hind legs: one front paw raised high toward the glowing tree, the other front paw resting on its hip, chest proud, bushy tail curled up, eyes half-closed with a satisfied look, mouth closed, soft snowflakes around it. Photorealistic, vertical composition.
shots.motion: Right from the first frame the ruddy Somali cat holds its paw-up final pose and bounces on its hind legs to the beat, giving two little hip sways and a slow proud head tilt toward the camera, raised paw staying high, bushy tail swishing. Fairy lights twinkle and snowflakes drift down. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

trend.why_now: In mid-November TikTok is turning cosy and festive, with the Christmas season officially kicked off and town tree lightings starting. AI cat dance clips (the dancing cat and the standing, clapping cat memes) are still the top AI pet format this month.
trend.pattern: an upright cat dancing to the beat with paw-pats right away in the first second, then a proud final pose, set at the season's first holiday-lights moment
